messages:
alex: Noticing an uptick in host-side p99 tail on small RPCs after yesterday's infra roll. Looks like kernel binner is choosing a scalar slowpath more often.

maria: noticed on prod-2 around 03:20 UTC. KV cache hit-rate dropped ~15% on the affected hosts, evictions spiked.

chen: perf snapshot from a repro host: 

```
$ sudo perf top -p 45321
 14.0%  libgrpc.so          grpc_chttp2_transport_parse
 10.5%  runtime.so          kernel_binner_select
  7.2%  runtime.so          kvcache_del
  4.5%  libc.so.6           writev
```

sam: eBPF trace shows sequences: tcp_sendmsg -> writev -> grpc_frame_build -> header_coalesce. Throttle of small writes increased; seems related to hpack encoder change in grpc 1.51 -> 1.53.

rachel: small repro: 100 concurrent http2 streams sending 2-token prompts repeatedly. p99 climbs in ~2-4m. I pushed a repro script to the incident gist.

priya: hypothesis: header coalescing changed observed micro-batch boundaries at ingress. Binner uses observed write sizes + token-count heuristic; now many requests look like "micro-batches" of single-token work, so kernel choice flips. That reduces KV cache reuse and increases eviction churn.

alex: also correlating with SDKs that enable keepalive + small SETTINGS payloads — increases frame frequency, which interacts badly with our write coalescing heuristics.

deploy-bot: rollout: runtime v2.3.1 to prod-2 at 2025-03-16T03:12Z

maria: triage checklist I'm running through:
- toggle grpc hpack change on a canary host (force_old_hpack=true)
- instrument ingress: emit minibatch_len histogram (buckets: 1,2,4,8,16) at 1% sampling
- add conservative kernel guard: force vector kernel for seq_len<=8 until safe
- run 30m soak with synthetic 2-token traffic

chen: I recorded flamegraph + heap profile on a warm host; will upload. Early look: kvcache_free_path increased allocations during evict.

sam: tentative remediation: 1) revert the HPACK encoder flag in GRPC; 2) land a kernel-binner smoothing window (50ms) so transient frame coalescing doesn't flip bins; 3) add eviction-rate alert for hosts.

alex: alternative: change batching policy to prefer time window over strict minibatch_count for small-request workloads. Might increase latency slightly but improve cache reuse.

priya: agree; we should run A/B: time-window batcher on canary vs current count-based. Also increase kvcache.bucket_size for affected hosts as temporary hotfix.

rachel: created alert rule: host.ingress.kv_evictions_per_min > 8 => page oncall. watching now.

chen: quick perf command I used for flame: 

```bash
sudo perf record -F 99 -p 45321 -g -- sleep 60
# then stackcollapse and flamegraph.svg
```

alex: PR posted with kernel-binner smoothing + opt-in time-window batcher: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4127 includes test harness, histograms, and flamegraphs.

maria: plan: rollback grpc hpack change on a single host in prod-2, enable kernel smoothing, run 2h soak with ingress histograms. If p99 returns to baseline, roll to rest of prod.

sam: I'll coordinate the rollback window at 06:00 UTC. prepping playbook and rollback steps.

priya: note: add unit test for binner to ensure write-size jitter doesn't flip bins for typical small-write distributions.

rachel: prod-2 metric update after small rollback on canary host: kv_evictions down 60%, p99 down ~18% on that host. Will keep it isolated till kernel-binner guard lands.

alex: good signal. Action items captured: 1) run full 2h soak with kernel smoothing; 2) land PR 4127 behind flag; 3) run A/B time-window batcher; 4) follow-up to evaluate long tail impact on latency and cost.

maria: follow-up: also check dedicated instances with high minibatch_size settings to ensure no regressions there.

chen: I'll post flamegraph + heaptrack links in this thread once upload completes.

sam: rollback started on prod-2 canary at 06:02 UTC. Will report when metrics stable.

rachel: metrics update @06:20 UTC: canary host p95/p99 back to baseline. Remaining hosts still showing elevated p99 until we propagate guard.

alex: thanks all 97 let's keep this thread for roll progress and perf artifacts.
